title: PMO floating surface simplicity and reference review
scope: PMO Teams floating workspace shell, title hierarchy, and drag isolation

references.name: a mature workbench FloatingTerminalPanelSurface
evidence: single inner surface and separate window controls

references.name: AgentMux workbench tabbar
evidence: actions share the same top row

decision.title: Use one compact utility rail and let the embedded Workbench own the Tab/Region chrome
rules: No large PMO title or permanent subtitle.
No duplicate titlebar above the Workbench root tabbar.
Keep the drag owner isolated from high-churn Workbench renders.
Keep pointer preview compositor-only and persist only at pointer end.

acceptance: The first visible PMO rail is 32-36px and uses metadata-sized identity text.
Removing the permanent subtitle does not remove accessible PMO identity.
Pointer movement does not trigger setState, localStorage, or a full Workbench render.
The embedded Tab/Region tools remain directly operable and no content is clipped.
